businessGoal: Enable visitors to easily find specific products within categories.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the category page is displayed with the correct products and title when a category name is clicked.
Ensure that the appropriate filters, sorting options, and pagination controls are present on the category page.

manual.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behavior and user interactions.

api.reason: The behavior of product categories and related data can be validated via API endpoints.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria explicitly mention UI elements and page behavior.
